card.line: Havilah is a region known for its pure gold, first named beside the river Pishon near Eden and later a marker for where people lived.

moments.title: Land of gold near Eden
moments.text: The river Pishon winds through the whole land of Havilah. The Bible says the gold there is pure, and bdellium and onyx are found there too.

moments.title: Where Ishmael's family settled
moments.text: Ishmael's descendants settled from Havilah to Shur, near the border of Egypt. They lived in hostility toward all their brothers.

moments.title: Saul strikes the Amalekites
moments.text: Saul struck down the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur, east of Egypt. But he and his troops spared King Agag and the best of the animals.
